text:
maya: Starting a short thread to lock the benchmark narrative for the launch week. Need one compact story we can use across: hero social post, webinar hook, and a gated benchmark download. Prefer a single hero stat + 2 supporting charts.
zane: For hero stat, recommend p95(chat) + cost-per-1k for batch. Example: "Observed p95 < 50ms on common chat prompt; $0.80 / 1k tokens for embeddings". Use the word "observed" not "guaranteed".
oliver: Charts I'd back: 1) Scatter (median latency vs cost/1k) with deployment-mode shapes, 2) Waterfall showing savings components (batching, cache, quantization) across scenarios. Keep axes labeled with units and a footnote on prompt and seq length.
rachel: Webinar format: 25 minutes total. 6min framing (real customer problems), 10min live walkthrough of the two charts + quick routing demo, 6min quick wins (how to shave tokens), 3min CTA + next steps. CTA variants: PLG -> start free trial, Enterprise -> request private trial.
maya: Inbound form fields to capture: workload (chat/batch/embedding), priority (latency/cost), monthly token estimate, current infra (self-hosted/cloud). Then route: latency -> fast demo SDR, cost -> nurture with case study.
zane: Copy hooks to iterate on: A) "Predictable tails. Lowered price." B) "Benchmark-backed inference decisions." C) "Spend less per successful response." My vote: A for enterprise hero, C for PLG social.
oliver: For visuals: use muted background + bold point colors. Add iso-contours showing same cost/latency tradeoff to help PMs see sweet spots. Also include a small appendix table: prompt type, seq len, median, p95, p99, cost/1k.
maya: Benchbot, can you paste the latest run summary?
benchbot: automated: latest-run-1759991000.csv attached. quick summary: median(chat)=11ms, p95(chat)=52ms, host_cost/1k=$0.87, dedicated p95 reduction avg 28%. caching delta example: prefix cache saved ~34% tokens for multi-turn.
zane: Can we craft a single-line headline for social? Ideas: "Speed you can predict. Costs you can plan." or "Measure latency, optimize dollars."
rachel: Social needs a CTA: "See the benchmark & join the webinar". Email subject lines: 1) "New benchmark: how fast + cheap is inference now" 2) "Benchmark: where to trade latency for cost". Keep subject 50 chars or less.
olm: (typo) ignore
maya: Action items: oliver -> produce mock CSV + iso-contour script by Tue, zane -> 4 social captions + 3 email subjects by EOD Mon, rachel -> webinar landing copy + CTA mapping, benchbot attach reproducibility notes. We'll run a small A/B on hero copy after first live impressions.
zane: Quick note on claims: wherever we say "99.9% under X ms" we must add a methodology footnote with sample size and prompt. Also avoid absolute SLA phrasing.
maya: Agreed. Also prepare a short reproducibility appendix for the gated download: dataset prompts, seq lengths, model variants, deployment configs. That will reduce support requests.
benchbot: automated: reproducibility-note: dataset=bench-common-prompts-v2, median sample size=50k requests, seq len=avg 78 tokens.
maya: Great. I'll stitch this into a one-pager and assign Figma mock review. Back with drafts tomorrow. :rocket:
